rows.text: You open your eyes. Sunlight glints off the glass facades of skyscrapers, while a stream of aerocars stretches into the sky like a long dragon. Time to go to work. You hop out of the billboard you call home, fishing a tie and a suit out of a briefcase that consists of nothing but line art.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: As one of the first batch of imagenae salvaged by the Worlds Reborn Initiative, you witnessed these skyscrapers rising from the ground up. The IPC granted you human rights and invited you to join this tide of universalization. The cost? Well, even imagenae have to clock in for work.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Your Wishpower balance is nearing the danger line." The digital watch scribbled in crayon on your wrist squawks. If you don't have enough Wishpower to sustain your body, you'll have to compete with the graffiti on the walls for work. By then, you won't be far from disappearing completely.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: *Clang!* Something suddenly flies out of the trashcan and smacks you right in the back of the head. You spin around in anger, only to discover it's a blank mask...
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: The Phantasmoon gazes quietly from the edge of the sky, wearing a goofy grin. You understand that with this gift, you can rewrite your destiny however you please, and it all depends on where you want to lead it.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: And so, the first Phantasmoon Games after the reconstruction begins...
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
